headline: OAK @ SFG matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is OAK 4.89 at SFG 4.64, with a projected total of 9.53. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward OAK: OAK moved +0.19 runs while SFG moved -0.81, changing the projected margin by +0.99 runs. The projected total fell -0.62, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. Pitching context: Gage Jump has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.6 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Casey Schmitt, Zack Gelof, Luis Arraez, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Colby Thomas, Carlos Cortes because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
